## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 47 captures during December 2019. Capture activity was maintained throughout the month, and session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity indicates that the site continued to provide a consistent service during the reporting period. No operational issues affecting the overall capture volume were identified in the information provided.

## Image quality

Of the 47 captures, 1 was ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.1. The result should be considered when reviewing the quality of images submitted by the site. Overall, the number of ungradable captures was limited, although continued attention to image acquisition and submission processes remains appropriate. Any learning from the ungradable case should be incorporated into routine practice where relevant.

## Grading

There were 4 referable results during December 2019. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 days. This indicates that grading activity was completed with a short turnaround for most submissions. The referable results should continue through the established clinical review and follow-up arrangements. Overall, activity, image quality and grading performance were monitored for the month, with no additional operational concerns recorded.
